reflection.text:
The run anchored on a dose split: 3 uM showed enlarged nuclei (nuc_major_axis z +15.2, nuc_area z +9.8) with atlas DNA damage 7/10 (e4), while 10/30/100 uM showed extreme tubulin texture (tub_glcm_contrast z +21.9/+42.5/+28.0) with low nuc_solidity and atlas Microtubule stabilizers 7/10 at 30 uM (e5) and 5/10 at 10 uM (e16). That dose-emergent bright bundled tubulin plus dose_response rho +0.80 drove the 0.75 Microtubule stabilizer call, with unblinding revealing ALLN, a calpain/proteasome inhibitor (PMID 12768477), truth Protein degradation.
What misled me was treating texture magnitude and taxane/docetaxel atlas similarity as mechanistically specific. Proteasome block stabilizes cell-cycle regulators (PMID 15125768) and p53/p21 (PMID 10914553), which can secondarily produce G2/M arrest, microtubule bundling appearance, multinucleation (frac_multinucleate_proxy rho +0.80, replicate z +7.7 in e19) and cell loss (cell_count rho -0.80). I discounted the early Protein degradation 1/10 hit in e5, kept it at p 0.01 to 0.005, and misread low-dose enlargement as primary DNA damage.
The acquisition choice compounded this: I spanned onset/transition/maximum and replicated discordant 3 uM, but then pursued only tubulin/nuclear dose_responses (e11-e15) and visual bundling checks rather than a discriminating proteasome readout. No ubiquitin, proteasome-activity, or in vitro polymerization control was acquired to separate direct MT stabilization from indirect mitotic failure.

Captured transitional multinucleation and large-nucleus signal (frac_multinucleate_proxy rho +0.80, e19 z +7.7, frac_large_nucleus z +4.9) that fits secondary mitotic failure rather than pure DNA damage.
Registered Protein degradation in the 30 uM atlas (1/10 in e5) and replicated the discordant 3 uM profile, preserving the conflict instead of hiding it.
what_was_wrong: Overweighted extreme tub_glcm_contrast at 30 uM (z +42.5, e3) persisting at 10 uM (+21.9, e9) and 100 uM (+28.0, e20) plus atlas 7/10 Microtubule stabilizers (e5) as taxane-specific evidence for 0.75.
Assigned 3 uM enlarged-nucleus profile (e2) to DNA damage via e4 atlas 7/10 and e6 phenotype, missing p53/p21 accumulation after proteasome inhibition as an alternative cause of nuclear enlargement.

Left Protein degradation at p=0.01 to 0.005 in both hypothesis updates and chose tubulin texture dose_response (e11) over a proteasome-discriminating test like ubiquitin/p53 or cell-free polymerization.

citations.claim: ALLN is N-acetyl-leucyl-leucyl-norleucinal studied as an apoptosis-inducing protease inhibitor.
Proteasome inhibition causes accumulation of wt p53 and p21WAF1/CIP1 and induction of apoptosis.
D-type cyclins are unstable proteins degraded by a proteasome-dependent mechanism, linking proteasome block to cell-cycle arrest defects.

reflection.next_experiment: Compare ALLN to bortezomib/MG-132 versus paclitaxel in the same cells: assay proteasome activity (Suc-LLVY-AMC cleavage), ubiquitin-conjugate and p53/p21 accumulation by western/immunofluorescence, plus cell-free tubulin polymerization to test direct stabilization versus secondary mitotic arrest with phospho-H3 live imaging.

- Captured transitional multinucleation and large-nucleus signal (frac_multinucleate_proxy rho +0.80, e19 z +7.7, frac_large_nucleus z +4.9) that fits secondary mitotic failure rather than pure DNA damage.
- Registered Protein degradation in the 30 uM atlas (1/10 in e5) and replicated the discordant 3 uM profile, preserving the conflict instead of hiding it.

What was wrong or missed:
- Overweighted extreme tub_glcm_contrast at 30 uM (z +42.5, e3) persisting at 10 uM (+21.9, e9) and 100 uM (+28.0, e20) plus atlas 7/10 Microtubule stabilizers (e5) as taxane-specific evidence for 0.75.
- Assigned 3 uM enlarged-nucleus profile (e2) to DNA damage via e4 atlas 7/10 and e6 phenotype, missing p53/p21 accumulation after proteasome inhibition as an alternative cause of nuclear enlargement.
- Left Protein degradation at p=0.01 to 0.005 in both hypothesis updates and chose tubulin texture dose_response (e11) over a proteasome-discriminating test like ubiquitin/p53 or cell-free polymerization.

Proposed next experiment: Compare ALLN to bortezomib/MG-132 versus paclitaxel in the same cells: assay proteasome activity (Suc-LLVY-AMC cleavage), ubiquitin-conjugate and p53/p21 accumulation by western/immunofluorescence, plus cell-free tubulin polymerization to test direct stabilization versus secondary mitotic arrest with phospho-H3 live imaging.
